doc: states — the state bits of a semantic node. Each has a fixed bit; append-only.

state.name: disabled
state.doc: Present but not operable; actions other than `read` are refused.

state.name: focusable
state.doc: Can receive keyboard focus.

state.name: focused
state.doc: Has keyboard focus.

state.name: hovered
state.doc: A pointer is over it.

state.name: pressed
state.doc: Being pressed (pointer or key held).

state.name: checked
state.doc: On: a checkbox, switch, toggle button or checkable menu item.

state.name: mixed
state.doc: Neither checked nor unchecked (a tri-state checkbox).

state.name: selected
state.doc: Selected within its container (an option, a tab, a list item).

state.name: expanded
state.doc: Its controlled content is shown (a disclosure, a combo box, a tree item).

state.name: collapsible
state.doc: Can be expanded or collapsed; `expanded` tells which.

state.name: busy
state.doc: Being updated; its content may change soon.

state.name: hidden
state.doc: Not shown (kept in the tree for virtualised or off-screen content).

state.name: offscreen
state.doc: Outside the visible area of its scroll container.

state.name: invalid
state.doc: Its value fails validation.

state.name: required
state.doc: Must have a value before the form it belongs to is submitted.

state.name: readonly
state.doc: Its value can be read and selected but not changed.

state.name: editable
state.doc: Its text can be edited.

state.name: multiline
state.doc: A text field that accepts line breaks.

state.name: multiselectable
state.doc: A container in which several items can be selected.

state.name: modal
state.doc: A dialog that blocks the rest of the application.

state.name: default
state.doc: The default button of its dialog or form.

state.name: visited
state.doc: A link that has been followed.

state.name: animating
state.doc: Moving; bounds and values given are those of the target state.

state.name: removing
state.doc: Leaving the tree (exit animation); accepts no actions (S-4).
